## Summary

`templates/entity.template.ts` currently outputs the entity class without any descriptive comments or formatting guidance.

## Proposed Enhancements

- **Add file header and TypeDoc**
  - Insert `// Generated by node-gen` at the top of the file.
  - Add a TypeDoc block before the class declaration explaining the database table and its columns.
- **Support custom description**
  - Introduce an optional `{{entityDescription}}` placeholder for user supplied text.
  - Update `src/typeorm-entity-generator.ts` so this value is included when generating entities.
- **Ensure formatting**
  - Run Prettier on the template to keep it consistent with the project style.

These improvements will make generated entities easier to read and maintain.
